Developed by: BLACK HOLE STUDIO CAFE WITH LOVE FROM LITHUANIA By Team Herald Published: 14 November 2026 Share SHARE Vivek Menezes

Power games and realpolitik predominate contemporary diplomacy, but the newly published picture book Rudamina: The First Lithuanian in India is palpably different. Just over 70 charmingly illustrated pages, and launched last month in English translation at MoCA in Old Goa, this unusual diplomat-led creative project is an inspired “breath of fresh air” celebrating an intriguing twist of history connecting India’s smallest state to the largest Baltic country (to be fair, they are all quite small).
